details: Bitcoin surged past $61,000 and briefly touched $62,000 following weaker-than-expected US non-farm payrolls data. This eased concerns about future Federal Reserve rate hikes, providing a short-term boost to risk assets. However, the broader crypto market shows signs of fragility, with significant Bitcoin ETF outflows and many altcoins already experiencing bear market conditions, leading some analysts to suggest the market is at a "breaking point."
title: Crypto Market Mixed as Weak US Jobs Data Boosts Bitcoin, ETF Outflows Continue

details: BlackRock-backed Securitize has made a notable move by debuting its shares on the New York Stock Exchange, while simultaneously launching tokenized versions on the Solana and Avalanche blockchains. This development marks a significant step forward in the tokenization of real-world assets (RWA) and fosters greater integration between traditional financial markets and blockchain technology.
title: Securitize Launches Tokenized Shares on NYSE, Solana, and Avalanche

details: Erebor Bank, a crypto- and defense-focused startup backed by prominent investor Peter Thiel, is reportedly in discussions to secure new funding that could push its valuation beyond $8 billion. This potential valuation nearly doubles its previous assessment, highlighting significant growth and investor confidence in crypto-friendly financial institutions. The bank plans to expand its services to include US dollar stablecoin deposits and payments.
title: Peter Thiel-Backed Erebor Bank Targets $8 Billion Valuation

details: SBI Crypto, a subsidiary of the Japanese financial services giant SBI Holdings, has announced the closure of its Bitcoin mining pool by July 31, 2026. The pool currently accounts for approximately 2% of Bitcoin's total hashrate. This decision comes amidst increasing challenges within the mining industry, including falling mining margins and rising operational costs.
title: SBI Crypto to Cease Bitcoin Mining Pool Operations

details: Robinhood Chain has successfully launched its mainnet, forging key partnerships with dYdX and Arbitrum to facilitate on-chain trading. This expansion is expected to boost various integrated tokens such as LayerZero (ZRO), Morpho (MORPHO), and Lighter (LIT), which play crucial roles in its cross-chain bridging capabilities and decentralized exchange infrastructure.
title: Robinhood Chain Mainnet Live, Integrates dYdX and Arbitrum

details: Former U.S. President Donald Trump's latest financial disclosures reveal over $1.4 billion in income from his family's crypto ventures in 2025. These significant earnings, primarily from World Liberty Financial and Trump meme coins, establish digital assets as a major source of his wealth, following policies enacted during his administration that were perceived as favorable to the crypto industry.
title: Donald Trump Reports Over $1.4 Billion in Crypto Income
